preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 20.
For each test case, the number of nodes N and queries Q must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 100 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All node values A[i] must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes within the range of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N and a != b for a, b in queries)
preconditions.description: All queries must specify valid nodes a and b, with a not equal to b.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min(abs(A[x] - A[y]) for x, y in pairs))
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum absolute difference between node values for each query.
